brief.summary_1line: On Vibhishana’s counsel, Rama sends Lakshmana with monkey and bear forces to Nikumbhila to stop Indrajit’s sacrifice and engage him in battle.

image_candidates.scene_text: Lakshmana, armored and bow in hand, bows to Rama’s feet before marching toward the dark Nikumbhila Grove with Hanuman and the monkey host behind him.
A vast army of monkeys and bears surges through the forest as Lakshmana leads them toward the sacrificial grove where Indrajit prepares his ritual.
Lakshmana, like one entering darkness, pushes into the dense ranks of the demon army glittering with weapons and chariots beneath tall standards.
